meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI页面和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化验证UI的像素级正确性
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI pages and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated pixel-level UI verification

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在你构建或修改任何用户界面后，自动进行严格的视觉质量检查。它会截取屏幕截图，与参考图对比，并运行两个独立的审查流程，最终给出“通过”或“不通过”的结论。
howto.when: 当你构建或修改了网页界面或终端界面，并准备宣布完成时触发。也适用于怀疑界面出现回归问题、CJK 文本显示异常或布局溢出时。

say.text: 帮我检查这个新页面是否和设计稿一致。
检查这个终端界面的布局有没有溢出。
say.note: Claude 会捕获终端渲染结果，检查宽度和边框对齐。

say.text: 这个组件的 CJK 文字有没有被截断？
say.note: Claude 会专门检查中日韩文字的显示完整性。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically performs rigorous visual QA on any UI you build or modify. It captures screenshots, compares them with references, runs two independent review passes, and synthesizes a pass/fail verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggered after building or changing any web or terminal UI, before declaring it done. Also when suspecting regressions, CJK text clipping, or layout overflow.

say_en.text: Check if this new page matches the design mockup.
Check if this terminal UI layout overflows.
say_en.note: Claude will capture the terminal render and check width and border alignment.

say_en.text: Is the CJK text in this component clipped?
say_en.note: Claude will specifically check for CJK text display issues.
